verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB docs say it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so every ClickHouse client and driver connects unchanged. They also state that any BI or dashboard tool that connects to ClickHouse connects to ObsessionDB, naming Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau and DBeaver. Missing for 10: explicit mention of JDBC/ODBC drivers, per-tool BI integration guides beyond a list of names, and independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboard connectivity.
